policy.ghost: Keep escape, lying low and decisive capital sabotage or theft first. Scan at most24 known sites, rotating over callbacks. Keep existing cloak-lane affordability.
policy.shade: Before a cold military plan, consider at most8 stationary shades that are idle or already attacking their current province. Submit at most one local strike; retain other standing orders and remote military destinations.
policy.target: Actual generation at least2 MW, ready hostile site, generating port, no current disruption/cooldown, hidden paid unit and at least150 ◆ in default policy. Batteries alone do not qualify.
policy.sdk: Uses discovered site id/p/x/y, safe-conduct checks and an optional bounded route. Duplicate pending sabotageStructure yields no replacement order. No control allocation increase.

rejectedVariant.finding: The first 7000-remaining admission was safe in330 calls but could not produce strikes at scheduled ghost5000/shade7000 allowances. The final path uses bounded local work before optional cold military planning.

limits: Metered callbacks prove safe order production, not a successful in-world strike or a campaign benefit. Engine strike tests validate cost, visibility, radius, cooldown and power effects separately.
Real capture opportunity fields and site geometry are explicitly authored. The original real capture remains unchanged and is tested separately.
Source fixtures are public default programs. No player source or private player state is included.
